title: Ɗaanagol Goongɗinɓe
intro: E jamaanu mo goonɗinal ina hulɓinii, doole ina njiɗi ustude goonɗinal, fedde tokosere sukaaɓe yontaaji mbaɗi suɓngo ngo ina ɓuuɓna e nder duuɓi. Ɓe ndogi ko ɓe nganndi fof, ɓe ndarni reentaade e niɓɓere suuɗnde e dow tulde, ɓe mbaɗti hoolaare maɓɓe fof e Alla. Ko waɗi caggal ɗuum maa won maande nde alaa ɗo haaɗi wonande miijotooɓe.
clues: Min ngonnoo ko dental sagataa6e googcfin6e Joomiraacfo amen, O 6eydi min e ardinde.
Min ndarii e yeeso leñol amen, min mbiyi min noddataa laamɗo gooto so wonaa Alla.
Min ɗaɓɓitii reentaade e nder ngaska, min mbiyi: “Joom am, hokku min yurmeende ummoraade e hoore maa, ardin min no haanirta nii e geɗe amen.”
En ɗaaniima duuɓi keewɗi, naange ina ɓuuɓtoo e ŋoral amen, memotaako en.
Kuɗol amen ina lelii ina taarii e damal weendu nduu, ina reena min no reentortoo nii.
Nde min njippii, min nji’i no min njooɗiri, gooto e amen neldaama e kaalis ngam soodde nguura.

arabic: وَلَبِثُوا۟ فِى كَهْفِهِمْ ثَلَـٰثَ مِا۟ئَةٍۢ سِنِينَ وَٱزْدَادُوا۟ تِسْعًۭا
verse: And they remained in their cave for three hundred years and exceeded by nine. (18:25)
